name: The Holding Level
desc: Floor 0, the tutorial. Not on the ladder: it opens nothing and is left by the one-way gate into Threshold. A new life starts in its holding cell.

name: The Flooded Offices
desc: Find the toll stamp in the flooded offices. Drive out the vermin, search for the clerk’s daybook, and follow its room sequence to the collector.

name: The Long Hall
desc: Floor 2, the same building one storey up. Gate: 150 gold earned in total. Fight down the Long Hall, four stretches of 3 fights each; the far end’s third win clears the floor. The tutor, the quartermaster and a break room are off the hall.

name: The Descent
desc: Floor 3, the same building going down its stairwell. Gate: 600 gold earned in total. Each landing’s side room holds the floor plan to the next flight and a string anchor; the Hearing Room at the bottom holds the Puppet Bureaucrat, whose kill clears the floor.

name: The Greenwood
desc: Floor 4, woodland, hills and a ravine. Every hunt is endless, and goblin raid parties roll into them. Herbs, game meat and copper ore come from here. Clear: kill the Goblin Raid Leader at the Raid Camp.

name: The Mire
desc: Floor 5, a swamp and the caves under it. Gate: 12 goblins killed. Firetongues cast fire; hobgoblins fight with techniques you can learn by watching; the Hollows are dark. Clear: find the warren’s back door in the Hollows and kill the Hobgoblin Champion guarding it.

name: The Warren
desc: Floor 6, the goblin warren, two maps. Gate: 40 goblins killed. Three sabotages in the outer warren each take a level off the Goblin Warchief. Clear: kill the warchief in the Great Hall, which also opens prestige.

name: The South Ward
desc: Floor 7, the city’s south ward: bandits raiding the merchants and convoys that feed the city. The ward’s form depends on how many of the other three wards are cleared this run. None: 12 fights on the merchant road. One or two: siege the bandits’ camp in the salt flats, the stockade and the watchtowers, then the chief in his tent. All three: a demon in the burnt camp, for 24 in-game hours; floor 7 clears when it dies or when the time runs out.

name: The West Ward
desc: Floor 8, the city’s west ward, facing the forest: the forest gate, the old forest past it, and a rogue beast in the hunting lodge. The fighting in the city crowds the beasts into the forest, and the beast changes under it: with one or none of the other wards cleared it is the young form, with two or three the final form. Clear: win the lodge’s one fight.

name: The North Ward
desc: Floor 9, the city’s north ward: the cathedral close, the barrow fields past the north gate, and the ossuary’s keeper. With one or none of the other wards cleared it is a Death Squire, with two or three a Death Knight. Clear: win the ossuary’s one fight.

name: The East Ward
desc: Floor 10, the city’s east ward: the artificers’ row, the mine past the east gate, and an ore eater in the deep seam below it. The eater is at stage 1 with none of the other wards cleared and one stage larger for each one cleared, up to stage 4 with all three. Clear: win the deep seam’s one fight.

name: The Stronghold Road
desc: Floor 11. On your first climb here: the stronghold. Repair it through the steward’s two quests, then hold the wall through eight fights; the eighth ends the run in an automatic prestige, and the stronghold stays yours on every later run. On later runs: the door to your hold is in the gatehouse, and the road leads on to the harbor, where a join quest picks your side for the run. Clear: 8 crates won on the roadstead’s convoy and one fight won there.
